import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,3)]
    color=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(g[r+i][c+j]==0 for i,j in shape):
                for i,j in shape: out[r+i][c+j]=color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
